steps.caption: Open Transactions and the Lumen Harbour Tech transaction.
Section 2 compares the three positions for each term.
Rent: the client requires ₹92, you recommend ₹94, the landlord proposes ₹95. Agreed stays blank — a proposal is never an agreed term.
Area, lock-in and duration are agreed — they were confirmed with evidence.
Record a position: choose whose position it is and the term.
The value, and the source — every position needs one.
Section 5, the point tracker: each term's value and status — proposed, under negotiation, agreed, documented, verified.
Agreed is not the same as documented or verified against the executed agreement. Agreeing needs evidence.
Mark rent-free as Agreed, with the evidence.
Rent-free is now agreed. An agreed value is never overwritten — a change creates a new version.
